Emergency Funds
UCI Basic Needs Economic Crisis Grant
Students may request up to $3,000 to help with their financial crisis.
UCI Basic Needs Sponsored Housing
Provides up to 30-days of temporary housing with a meal plan at UCI for students who are currently facing homelessness.
UCI Basic Needs Emergency Meal Swipes
Application-based service that helps students who are experiencing food insecurity.
We hope you find these resources useful while navigating your time at UC Irvine. We will continuously update this page and if you have any recommendations for resources that you think should be listed below, please email Ash Hormaza, hormazaa@uci.edu.
